about: Ground-truth labels for the eBay validation candidates (fixtures/ebay/validation-2026-11-19.json kept listings). Drafted 2026-11-19 by three independent Opus readings with verbatim quotes, under the PO's packaging ruling (bulk, repackaged, no box and kit-pulled New listings count when the contents are exactly the product). labelledBy 'draft' until the owner checks one.
